scope: Cross-task external transfer: IQ-OTH/NCCD trained three-class CT-slice model vs LUNGx benign/malignant nodule labels
image_policy: One full nodule-containing DICOM slice; [-1000,400] HU; 224 resized; 64 granules (28x28); model per granule input=224; no ROI crop
disclaimer: An exploratory out-of-domain binary transfer experiment with task and image-representation mismatch. Does not verify clinical generalization to three-class CT-slice classification.
